notes: Abu Ibrahim (the Imam) speaks and acts inside the scene Haydar tells in the first person: source or only in the scene is for the ruling (rule 11)
«حَدَّثَنا أَبي» has no name at that place: relation link
The closing «قالَ علِىِّ بْنِ الحَكَمُ ماتَ حَيْدَرٌ» is a remark by a transmitter already in the chain: no new route
